details: A recent European Central Bank (ECB) survey across 8,205 companies in the euro area revealed that only 0.2% accept cryptocurrencies or stablecoins for online payments, and a mere 1% accept them at physical points of sale. Cash remains dominant, accepted by 92% of businesses with physical locations. Despite the MiCA regulatory framework offering clarity, EU payment firms have been slow to develop crypto solutions, highlighting a significant gap between crypto ambitions and actual commercial usage.
title: ECB Survey Shows Extremely Low Crypto Adoption in Eurozone Businesses

details: Mike McGlone, a Bloomberg Intelligence strategist, has updated his Bitcoin outlook, cautioning that the cryptocurrency risks a substantial price correction down to approximately $10,000. He suggests that past rallies were fueled by temporary stimuli like cheap liquidity and regulatory optimism, which are now diminishing. With ETF inflows drying up and macroeconomic forces shifting, Bitcoin's price may revert to its 2019-2020 historical average, further pressured by an oversupply of alternative tokens.
title: Bloomberg Strategist Warns Bitcoin Could Fall to $10,000 Amid Fading Hype

details: US inflation remained at 3.4% in July, aligning with Wall Street forecasts, while core prices cooled to 2.5%. This in-line report maintains a near 50/50 probability for a September Federal Reserve rate hike, according to CME FedWatch data. The softening employment report, which showed payrolls shrinking, argues for patience from the Fed, while persistent above-target inflation suggests potential for action.
title: US Inflation Holds Steady at 3.4%, Fed Hike Odds Remain a 'Coin Flip'

details: The mighty US consumer appears to be showing signs of strain, with July retail sales falling by 0.6%, the sharpest drop in a year and significantly below expectations. Consumer sentiment data from the University of Michigan for August also declined. These indicators, combined with earlier soft payroll data, suggest potential economic headwinds, highlighting political risks from persistent inflation and declining purchasing power.
title: US Consumer Sentiment Weakens as Retail Sales Fall Sharply

details: The Office of the Comptroller of the Currency (OCC) has granted conditional approval for World Liberty National Trust, a crypto business backed by the Trump family, to establish a bank charter. This development allows the firm to custody stablecoins and handle key banking functions for its digital assets, potentially paving the way for greater integration of digital assets into mainstream finance.
title: OCC Grants Conditional Approval for Trump-Backed World Liberty National Trust Bank

details: Wall Street has seen a renewed bullish trend in August, with the S&P 500 reaching a new record high. This surge in risk appetite is attributed to strong corporate earnings, particularly from technology and AI-linked companies, and easing inflation concerns. Institutional demand for U.S. information technology stocks has hit a five-year high, and speculative instruments like leveraged ETFs are regaining popularity. However, rising oil prices and mixed market signals introduce fragility to this optimistic outlook.
title: Wall Street Bull Market Resurges in August, Driven by AI and Easing Inflation
